title: Flan Napolitano
description: Flan Napolitano is a dish from Mexico prepared with chicken egg, evaporated milk, sweetened condensed milk, cream cheese. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Heat the listed ingredients over moderate heat, stirring only as needed, for about 9 minutes until amber and fragrant.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Gently cook the prepared contents in the simmering liquid from earlier steps until fully cooked and safe to eat.
Refrigerate the prepared mixture for about 200 minutes, cooling perishable foods promptly and never holding cooked rice warm at room temperature.
